title: Oz by The Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Poised just a short stroll from the pristine sands of Inlet Beach, this newly constructed coastal escape delivers luxury, comfort, and convenience in equal measure. Designed to impress, the home showcases stunning rooftop Gulf views and a private resort-style pool and spa, ideal for both peaceful mornings and festive evenings. Thoughtfully built with modern amenities like an elevator and a spacious game room, the layout is as functional as it is beautiful, effortlessly accommodating large groups across three stylishly appointed levels. With a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes included, guests can easily explore 30A’s charming communities, upscale dining, and boutique shopping. The spacious interiors offer refined living spaces and a variety of sleeping arrangements, making it ideal for multi-family vacations or special gatherings. Whether it’s lounging poolside, sharing sunsets on the balcony, or enjoying a chef-inspired dinner at home, every moment here feels curated for unforgettable coastal living.

Features: Outdoor seating Pool alarm Rooftop terrace
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
